from_quote: the persons elected should have the absolute controul over the time, manner and place of election
rationale: The paragraph names control by the persons elected over the time, manner and place of election, the power given to Congress in Article I, Section 4, clause 1.

from_quote: It begins in the name of the people, and not of the states.
rationale: The paragraph says the new system begins in the name of the people, which points at the opening words of the Preamble.
to_quote: We the People of the United States
